senses.gloss: f. (זיּב) gonorrhœa, protracted menstruation, legal condition of one suffering from &c., v. זָב.
units: Zab. II, 2; Naz. IX, 4 משנזקק לז׳ as soon as he is declared a zab. Y. Maas. Sh. II, end, 53ᵈ; a. fr.—
Men. 64ᵇ לזִיבָתִי I offer a sacrifice for my recovery from the condition of a zabah (v. זָבָה), or from a severe hemorrhage, v. זוֹב; Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ, v. next w.—Pl. זִיבוֹת.
